blogs.title: From Reinforcement Learning to Direct Preference Optimization: Why RLHF Isn’t the Only Way
blogs.description: An overview of the traditional RLHF pipeline, its complexities, and how the new Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) method sidesteps reinforcement learning altogether while achieving the same goal of aligning language models with human preferences.

blogs.title: The Mathematics Behind DPO: Turning a Reward Model into a Policy in Closed Form
blogs.description: A step‑by‑step walk‑through of the key equations that let DPO derive the optimal policy directly from preference data, including the Bradley‑Terry model, the change‑of‑variables trick, and the resulting binary cross‑entropy loss.

blogs.title: Hands‑On with DPO: Implementing the Simplest Preference‑Based Fine‑Tuning in Minutes
blogs.description: A practical guide for developers, featuring code snippets, data preparation tips, and hyper‑parameter tricks to fine‑tune a GPT‑style model using the DPO loss without any RL libraries.

blogs.title: Why DPO Beats PPO in Sentiment Control and Summarization Benchmarks
blogs.description: An accessible analysis of the experimental results showing DPO’s superior reward‑KL trade‑off, better win‑rates on summarization and dialogue tasks, and its robustness to temperature and sampling settings.

blogs.title: Beyond Text: How Direct Preference Optimization Could Shape Future Generative AI
blogs.description: Explores the broader implications of DPO for other modalities (images, audio, video) and for tasks like self‑labeling, offline preference learning, and large‑scale alignment, highlighting open research questions and future directions.
